name: Düsseldorf
registryBasis: The Düsseldorf Vermessungs- und Katasteramt maintains the city cadastral/Geoportal services; the city Geoportal describes over 120,000 searchable Flurstücke and the NRW ALKIS WFS returns a parcel polygon covering the ranked point.

verifiedParcelResponse.requestFilter: WFS 2.0.0 BBOX (2 m × 2 m envelope centered on WUP coordinate) 345140.447,5676407.464,345142.447,5676409.464 in EPSG:25832
verifiedParcelResponse.limitations: One parcel at the WUP point only; no citywide completeness claim. Server response included non-owner standard fields beyond the requested propertyName; only the safe parcel IDs and geometry were retained.

queries.query: Düsseldorf ALKIS WFS Geobasis NRW Flurstücke polygon WFS official
queries.scope: Find a public official parcel layer, safe native parcel identifier, and exact coverage at Düsseldorf’s ranked point.
queries.result: The City of Düsseldorf Geoportal and Geoshop document the municipal cadastral office and parcel mapping. Geobasis NRW publishes the INSPIRE CadastralParcel WFS in EPSG:25832. A bounded 2 m envelope around the ranked point returned one Polygon carrying nationalCadastralReference; GEOS confirms it covers the point.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English search, official city map/catalog pages, WFS capabilities/schema inspection, and one anonymous geometry query capped at three features.

queries.query: Düsseldorf offizielle ALKIS Flurstücke WFS Geoportal Katasterkarte
queries.scope: Das kommunale Liegenschaftskataster und den anonym nutzbaren Flurstücksdienst am Rangpunkt prüfen.
queries.result: Das Geoportal Düsseldorf und der GeoShop beschreiben das Liegenschaftskataster und Flurstücke. Der offizielle NRW-WFS „cp:CadastralParcel“ verwendet EPSG:25832. Eine begrenzte 2-m-Abfrage am WUP-Punkt lieferte ein gültiges Polygon, das den Punkt enthält; gespeichert wurden nur Geometrie und Flurstücksreferenz.
queries.executionMethod: Getrennte deutschsprachige Recherche, Prüfung offizieller Stadtseiten und WFS-Metadaten sowie eine anonyme, begrenzte Abfrage.

source.name: Geobasis NRW ALKIS parcels
source.scope: 162 valid, distinct NRW ALKIS cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Düsseldorf WUP locator. Complete offset paging, forced three-row pages, all 162 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32632 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The existing North Rhine-Westphalia provider is reused. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.
source.identityBasis: Fresh bounded adapter qualification uses the publisher native cadastral key, preserving complete geometry and separate transport IDs.
